title: August 2016 Central Italy earthquake
summary: A Mw 6.2 earthquake struck central Italy in the night of 24 August 2016, near Accumoli. It razed the medieval town of Amatrice and surrounding hamlets and caused all the casualties of the sequence's first main shock. Together with the October shocks, the sequence killed almost 300 people.
